title: A Trip to the Shop
text:
Anna goes to the shop on Monday. She needs milk, bread and eggs. The shop is near her house. She takes a small basket.

At the shop, she pays at the desk. The price of the milk is two dollars. The bread is cheap today, so she is happy. She goes home with her shopping.

questions.text: What does Anna need to buy?
How does Anna probably feel at the end of her trip?
What can we guess about Anna's shopping?
options: She buys only a few things.
She buys a lot of meat.
She buys things for a party.

vocabulary.definition: a place where you buy things
a container you carry to hold the things you buy
the amount of money you pay for something

paragraph_translations: Anna pazartesi günü dükkana gider. Süt, ekmek ve yumurta almaya ihtiyacı var. Dükkan evinin yakınında. Küçük bir sepet alır.
Dükkanda masada ödeme yapar. Sütün fiyatı iki dolar. Ekmek bugün ucuz olduğu için mutlu. Alışverişiyle birlikte eve döner.
